replacements.instruction: Table 2 の citation 追加を維持しつつ、既存 caption の reader takeaway『central difference in what advances next』を復元して caption guard と整合させる。表本体は変えない。
replacements.before: \caption{Operational comparison of the evaluated writing systems. \condStaged\ operationalizes fixed planning--drafting--revision stages following prior staged writing systems~\citep{yang2022re3,wan2025cognitive}; \condTaskPlanning\ operationalizes a WriteHERE-style adaptive task graph~\citep{xiong2025beyond}. $X$ is the fixed task input; $D_t$, $G_t$, and $H_t$ are the current draft, goals, and process history; $T_t$ is the task graph. The remaining rows modify \condAgenticCogWriter; \condSingleContext\ was added post-hoc.}
replacements.after: \caption{Operational comparison of the evaluated writing systems. \condStaged\ follows fixed planning--drafting--revision stages~\citep{yang2022re3,wan2025cognitive}; \condTaskPlanning\ follows WriteHERE-style task planning~\citep{xiong2025beyond}. The first four rows expose the central difference in what advances next: a whole document, a fixed stage, a task node, or a writing process. $X$ is the task input; $D_t$, $G_t$, and $H_t$ are draft, goals, and process history; $T_t$ is the task graph. The remaining rows modify \condAgenticCogWriter; \condSingleContext\ was added post-hoc.}
